items.content: Plan around irregular income: Aurora smooths lumpy freelance pay into a steady weekly budget you can actually trust.

Meet Aurora

If you freelance, you know the pattern: three invoices land in one week, then nothing for a month. Most budgeting apps assume a salary. Aurora doesn't.

Aurora looks at what you've earned over the last six months and turns it into a steady weekly amount you can spend without second-guessing. When a big payment arrives, the surplus goes into a buffer. When things are slow, the buffer pays you.

That's it. No categories to maintain, no guilt-trip notifications. One number each week, and a buffer that tells you how many quiet weeks you can ride out.

Aurora is free for your first three months. Connect your bank, answer two questions, and see your weekly number in under a minute.

We built Aurora because we were tired of feast-or-famine months ourselves. We hope it gives you a little calm too.
